title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 40: comfort for God's people, the voice in the wilderness, and the Creator who renews the strength of those who wait.

questions.text: With which words does this chapter open?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens, "Comfort, comfort my people," says your God.

answers.text: "Comfort, comfort my people," says your God
"Hear, O heavens, and listen, O earth"
"Woe to the rebellious children"
"Arise, shine, for your light has come"

questions.text: What is to be called out to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem is to be told that her warfare is accomplished and her iniquity is pardoned.

answers.text: That her king is coming on a donkey
That her walls will be rebuilt in seven years
That her warfare is accomplished and her iniquity is pardoned
That her enemies will serve her forever

questions.text: What does the voice call out to prepare in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: The voice calls out, "Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God."

answers.text: A city of refuge
An altar of stones
A well of living water
The way of Yahweh

questions.text: What shall happen to every valley?
questions.explanation: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low.

answers.text: It shall be filled with water
It shall be exalted
It shall be made low
It shall blossom like a rose

questions.text: According to the voice, what is all flesh like?
questions.explanation: The voice says that all flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of the field.

answers.text: Grass
Dust
A passing shadow
A breath of wind

questions.text: While the grass withers and the flower fades, what stands forever?
questions.explanation: The grass withers and the flower fades, but the word of our God stands forever.

answers.text: The mountains of Zion
The throne of David
The heavens and the earth
The word of our God

questions.text: How will the Lord Yahweh feed his flock?
questions.explanation: He will feed his flock like a shepherd, gather the lambs in his arm and carry them in his bosom.

answers.text: Like a king at a great banquet
Like a farmer scattering seed
Like a shepherd, gathering the lambs in his arm
Like an eagle feeding its young

questions.text: What are the nations like before him?
questions.explanation: The nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance.

answers.text: A drop in a bucket and a speck of dust on a balance
A roaring sea and a mighty rushing flood
A field white and ready for the harvest
Stars that cannot be counted for number

questions.text: What are the inhabitants of the earth like to him who sits above the circle of the earth?
questions.explanation: He sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers.

answers.text: Ants on a hill
Grasshoppers
Sheep in a pasture
Sparrows on a roof

questions.text: What will those who wait for Yahweh do?
questions.explanation: Those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength and mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not be weary.

answers.text: Inherit all the cities of the land of Judah
Behold the glory and the beauty of Lebanon
Lie down and rest beside the still waters
Renew their strength and mount up with wings like eagles
